command: Trace scheduled reconciliation from recoveredLineage through resilienceExecutor.reconcile to unconditional CpfContexts.requireSnapshot
actualResult: The @Scheduled reconciliation worker creates a recovery-only call context from persisted canonical transaction lineage and invokes reconcile without binding a current CPF context. CpfResilienceEngine nevertheless unconditionally requires a current snapshot in executeAttempts. Therefore the real scheduled UNKNOWN reconciliation path fails before invoking its probe.
